about: Counts of state swine (hog) operation permit and registration records within 50 miles of each FSIS establishment, for the FAT apps' Nearby Hog Farm card. Prepared by Dirk Adams with the assistance of AI. Aggregates only: no farm names, owner names, farm coordinates or permit numbers are published. Counts are records in each state's published data, not a census of all hog farms.

method.plants: FSIS Meat, Poultry and Egg Product Inspection Directory (MPI Directory by Establishment Number CSV, downloaded 2026-10-09), keyed by establishment_id; every establishment with coordinates. Plants with no operation within 50 miles and no not-published state in range are omitted.
method.distance: Great-circle distance (Earth radius 3,958.8 miles) from the plant coordinates to each operation, 50 miles or less.
method.statesReached: States a 50-mile circle reaches, sampled every 5 miles on a 0.1-degree state grid from Census TIGERweb state boundaries (simplified).
method.lagoon: 'l' counts operations whose record lists at least one waste lagoon; only states with lagoon:true publish lagoon data.
method.npdes: 'np' counts operations holding a federal Clean Water Act NPDES permit; only states with npdes:true carry an NPDES flag (others are unknown).
method.parents: 'ph' counts permits held by entities mapped to a processor parent on an exact normalised name: smithfield = Murphy-Brown LLC, Murphy-Brown of Missouri LLC, Smithfield Hog Production (Smithfield Foods 10-K Exhibit 21.1, 2026); seaboard = Seaboard Foods LLC (Seaboard Corp. FY2025 10-K Exhibit 21). Contract-grower farms are permitted under the grower's name, so these are minimums.
method.fields: plants.<establishment_id>: n = total operations; s = operations by published state reached (0 = reached, none listed); l = with at least one lagoon; np = with an NPDES permit; ph = parent-held permits by state; u = states reached that publish no usable data (not counted).

NC.agency: North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality, Division of Water Resources
NC.label: NC DEQ
NC.basis: Active swine permits on DEQ's Animal Feeding Operation Permits layer (DESC_ LIKE 'Swine%'), one per permit number. Expiration dates are not used as a filter (2019 general-permit COCs show a 2024 expiration while still Active). Lagoon = Number Of Lagoons > 0 on DEQ's April 23, 2026 List of Permitted Animal Facilities; 106 active permits on the layer are not on that list, so they have no lagoon data and are not counted as lagoon farms. NPDES = permit number starting NCA or NC0 (state-only permits start AWS, AWI, AWC or ADS).

MN.label: MPCA
MN.basis: Active feedlot records with swine (swine_big + swine_medium + swine_little > 0), one per permit number (registration number when there is no permit), downloaded 2026-10-09. Two Tyson hog buying stations and the Hormel Austin plant holding pens are removed (not farms). NPDES = npdes_sds field is NPDES/SDS (SDS-only and blank = no NPDES permit).

MO.label: MoDNR
MO.basis: Class I CAFO operating permits with status Effective and swine on the permit, one point per permit (primary feature). Smaller farms are not in this layer. Lagoon = a storage lagoon or wastewater treatment lagoon listed for the permit. NPDES = MOG01 general or MO-0 site-specific permit number; MOGS (state no-discharge general permit) numbers are not NPDES permits and are not in EPA ECHO (checked 2026-10-09).

IA.label: Iowa DNR
IA.basis: Facilities with any swine on Iowa DNR's AFO geodatabase (animal_feeding_operations layer), which covers facilities of 300 or more animal units and was last updated April 5, 2024. NPDES = an NPDES permit issue date is listed (the literal 'NULL' means none). Same basis as FAT's pork enforcement maps.

NE.agency: Nebraska Department of Water, Energy, and Environment
NE.label: NDEE/DWEE
NE.basis: Livestock waste control facilities with an active swine program record. The bulk layer has no usable NPDES field, so NPDES status is unknown.

IN.label: IDEM
IN.basis: Confined feeding operation approvals with at least one pig, one per approval number. NPDES = an NPDES coverage type is recorded.

MI.agency: Michigan Department of Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy
MI.label: EGLE
MI.basis: CAFO permits reporting swine (2024 report year layer). These are NPDES permits (MIG01 general or MI00 individual numbers). Coordinates are rounded by EGLE to about 1 km.

notPublished.TX: TCEQ publishes CAFO permits (TXG92 general and individual) with no species field, so swine permits cannot be identified.
notPublished.OK: No public swine LMFO list found (ODAFF).
notPublished.OH: No public ODA permit list; Ohio EPA NPDES CAFO layer has no swine.
notPublished.IL: No statewide list (IEPA CAFO data by FOIA only).
notPublished.other: All other states: no state swine permit dataset ingested.
